_meta.name: Render Enhancement
_meta.description: Enhances an uploaded architectural render into a photorealistic visualization guided by the source image (FLUX 3 Image Klein).
_meta.license_notes: FLUX 3 Image Klein (5.6B, step-distilled, int8): FLUX Kommunity License - free commercial use only for individuals/organisations under US$5M annual revenue; larger organisations need a licence from Black Forest Labs. Text encoder qwen3vl_4b and flux2-vae under their own licences. Runs fully offline.

parameters.label: Sampling Steps

inputs.text: Enhance the uploaded architectural render into a photorealistic, high-end architectural visualization. Treat the source image as the fixed design reference. Preserve the visible building massing, floor count, structural grid, parking openings, ramps, façade proportions, window and door positions, signage, storefront layout, camera angle, perspective, and overall composition as closely as possible. Improve only material realism, concrete and stone texture, physically plausible glass reflections, metal finishes, natural daylight, shadows, planting, and surface detail. Maintain open parking façades and natural ventilation. Do not add or remove floors, move structural elements, close openings, or redesign the architecture.

extra floors, missing floors, changed building massing, distorted geometry, warped perspective, changed camera angle, moved columns, closed parking openings, missing ramps, altered window layout, altered storefronts, illegible signage, text overlay, watermark, blurry details, low resolution, oversaturated colors, cartoon, plastic materials, excessive vegetation covering the façade
